title: Tailoring the dynamic nanocomposite hydrogels through surface-functionalized nanomaterials and interfacial crosslinking chemistry toward multifunctional biomedical and engineering applications
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5CS00975H, Review Article
Yu-Chia Su, Grace Chen, Yi-Jhen Lai, Guo-Zen Song, Tai-Lin Wu, Yi-Cheun Yeh
The integration of the surface-functionalized nanomaterials with dynamic interfacial crosslinks enables the fabrications of versatile dynamic nanocomposite hydrogels (DNCHs) with tunable structures, properties, and functionalities.
